mods.name: Optimize Server Replay
mods.description: Reduces the load of Server Replay recordings by filtering the packets that get recorded.

releases.notes:
Keeps a recording paused when Server Replay resumes it after nothing has happened for `pause_when_idle_seconds`, so that no snapshot is taken for nothing.

- Count the time towards `pause_when_idle_seconds` while Server Replay keeps a recording paused too, for example while every player in the area is in spectator mode. Once it has passed, the recording stays paused when Server Replay resumes it, until a block action or an arm swing happens. Before, the recording resumed and took a new snapshot, only to be paused again once the time had passed ([#10](https://github.com/panyaaa256/optimize-server-replay/pull/10))

mods.name: Optimize Server Replay
mods.description: Reduces the load of Server Replay recordings by filtering the packets that get recorded.

releases.notes:
Changes what keeps a recording going with `pause_when_idle_seconds`: only block actions and the arm swings of players count now. `idle_ignore_entities` and `idle_entity_whitelist` are no longer used, so you can delete them from your `config.json`.

### Added
- Tell everyone when `pause_when_idle_seconds` pauses or resumes a recording, with the same messages as Server Replay, while `pause_notify_players` is on in Server Replay ([#9](https://github.com/panyaaa256/optimize-server-replay/pull/9))

### Changed
- Count only block actions (pistons, note blocks, chests, bells and so on, apart from spawners and end gateways) and the arm swings of players as activity for `pause_when_idle_seconds`. Block changes, the movement of entities and level events no longer count, so sheep eating grass, crops growing and players who only walk around no longer keep a recording going. Neither do players who stand still, whose position the server sends every 3 seconds ([#9](https://github.com/panyaaa256/optimize-server-replay/pull/9))
- Count block actions and arm swings even when `ignore_block_action`, `block_update_interval_ticks` or `ignore_entities` leave them out of the recording ([#9](https://github.com/panyaaa256/optimize-server-replay/pull/9))

### Removed
- Remove `idle_ignore_entities` and `idle_entity_whitelist` ([#9](https://github.com/panyaaa256/optimize-server-replay/pull/9))

mods.description: Reduces the load of Server Replay recordings by filtering the packets that get recorded.

releases.notes:
Fixes entities that `idle_entity_whitelist` leaves out keeping a recording from pausing with `pause_when_idle_seconds`.

- Fix bats and some other entities keeping a recording from pausing, or resuming it, even when they are not in `idle_entity_whitelist`. The level events that only entities send in vanilla, such as a bat taking off, no longer count as a change. See [docs/packets.md](docs/packets.md#level_event-that-only-entities-send) for the list ([#8](https://github.com/panyaaa256/optimize-server-replay/pull/8))

mods.name: Optimize Server Replay
mods.description: Reduces the load of Server Replay recordings by filtering the packets that get recorded.

releases.notes:
Adds an option to pause a Flashback chunk recording when nothing changes in its area for a while. Your `config.json` does not have the new keys, so the mod logs a warning for each and uses its default (off) until you add them.

- Add `pause_when_idle_seconds`, off by default. It pauses a recording when the blocks and entities in its area have not changed for that many seconds, and resumes it when something changes, so that a player left idle in the area no longer keeps an empty recording going. `idle_ignore_entities` and `idle_entity_whitelist` choose which entities count as a change; by default only players do, and players in spectator mode never do ([#7](https://github.com/panyaaa256/optimize-server-replay/pull/7))

mods.name: Optimize Server Replay
mods.description: Reduces the load of Server Replay recordings by filtering the packets that get recorded.

releases.notes:
Shortens the time the server stops when a Flashback chunk recording starts and for its snapshots, when there are many entities. Your `config.json` does not have the new key, so the mod logs a warning and uses its default until you add it.

- Add `optimize_snapshot`, on by default. For each chunk it sent at the start of a recording and in a snapshot, Server Replay went through every entity of the world; the entities are now sorted into their chunks once. The recorded packets stay the same ([#5](https://github.com/panyaaa256/optimize-server-replay/pull/5))

readmeSummary: An addon for Server Replay that reduces the load in various situations, by leaving the packets you choose out of its chunk recordings.
